summary: Opaque native.node addon with browser-credential-stealer scaffolding loaded on require()
details: The package ships a single 10MB Linux x86_64 native N-API addon (tools.linux-x64-gnu.node) declared as the package main and loaded when the module is require()'d, with no source, no JS wrapper, no binding.gyp, and a two-line README that does not describe any functionality. Readable strings inside the binary include browser-credential-stealer scaffolding: 'Found login for' and 'TSQLITE_AUTH_USER' (Chromium-family Login Data SQLite handling), an embedded HTTP/TLS client (ureq_proto, rustls, TLS handshake types, RSA_PKCS1_SHA384), the ChaCha20 constant 'expand 32-byte k0', broad host and network enumeration (/dev/disk/by-id/, /etc/lsb-release, cpu.cfs_quota_us, bogomips, network_adapters, gethostname, getifaddrs), and process-spawn primitives (posix_spawnp, execvp). The version string '3.1.41-as2-9980-test-400-1785776624' carries a unix-timestamp suffix and a 'test' tag consistent with a throwaway publish. The combination of undocumented purpose, opaque native payload executed on require(), Chromium credential-store handling, embedded outbound HTTP/TLS client, symmetric-crypto scaffolding, and host/network recon in one artifact is the shape of a credential-harvesting dropper targeting the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
